# Acoustic

> Acoustic is an intent-driven lifecycle marketing platform that enables brands to orchestrate personalized omnichannel campaigns across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and mobile app messaging.

Acoustic Connect provides marketers with real-time audience segmentation, behavior analytics, and AI-powered automation to drive customer engagement and loyalty across retail, ecommerce, media, travel, and financial services industries. The platform integrates with leading ecommerce solutions like Shopify and BigCommerce.

## Core Platform

- [Intent-driven lifecycle marketing platform | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/acoustic-connect): Main product page for Acoustic Connect, the intent-driven lifecycle marketing platform.
- [Omnichannel messaging & orchestration | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/omnichannel-messaging-orchestration): Omnichannel messaging and journey orchestration capabilities of Acoustic Connect.
- [Real-time audience data & segmentation | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/audience-segmentation): Real-time audience segmentation using consumer behavior and intent data.
- [Behavior analytics & reporting for marketers | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/reporting-analytics): Behavior analytics and reporting features for understanding consumer engagement.

## Messaging Channels

- [Email marketing tools | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/email-marketing): AI-powered email marketing tools with personalization and campaign automation.
- [SMS and WhatsApp marketing tools | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/sms-whatsapp-marketing): SMS and WhatsApp marketing tools for seamless multi-channel campaigns.
- [Mobile app messaging | Acoustic](https://www.acoustic.com/product/mobile-app-messaging): Mobile app messaging with push notifications and behavior-driven personalization.
